change: Versioned actor and coordinator projections jointly rank source-classified observations, proven terminal goals/threads and resolved commitments. The complete canonical state still supplies visibility and stale hashes; old readers reproduce original inputs.

Mandatory roots include unclassified facts, durable object/place/character facts, unfinished or paused matters, beliefs/plans, discovery conditions and results, inquiry results, visited places, latest known consequences and pending actions. Pins, pending corrections, selected relationship reasons and their source-event facts stay protected.

Every selected unit expands its authorized dependency closure. Selected goals include original and terminal fact references plus their latest commitment disposition; selected commitments retain their own goal when authorized and facts from declaration/request/resolution events. Shared promises never disclose private goals.

Closed matters include exact original expression excerpts; excluded dialogue does not erase canonical resolution evidence. Role selection cannot expose unknown dependency identities or private omission counts.

Coordinator review protects the actor-delivered rows and explicit existing candidate references before selecting additional history. Context packets preserve decisions and versions; coordinator manifests retain compact included/omitted identities and required reasons.

Current-scene player statements are protected beyond the old recent-message count. Required closure exceeding the unchanged budget stops before sending; no arbitrary truncation, automatic retry, state reset or lost obligation.

Historical input inspection shows only shared fact and thread selections. Recent commitment disposition is labeled as such. Full stored facts, statuses, source references and old candidate adoption behavior remain unchanged.
